title.value: Stringency of containment and closures on the growth of SARS-CoV-2 in Canada prior to accelerated vaccine roll-out
title.justification: The title explicitly states the focus of the study on SARS-CoV-2 containment and closure policies in Canada before the widespread vaccine rollout.
title.quote: Stringency of containment and closures on the growth of SARS-CoV-2 in Canada prior to accelerated vaccine roll-out

extractions.description: The paper examines the effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on SARS-CoV-2 transmission in Canada prior to the accelerated vaccine roll-out by exploring the relationship between case growth and a stringency index across different provinces.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on public health measures related to the COVID-19 pandemic without significant emphasis on climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Many studies have examined the effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on SARS-CoV-2 transmission worldwide.

primary_category.justification: The study focuses on pandemic response strategies related to COVID-19, which do not directly pertain to climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
primary_category.quote: The minimal association in the first wave and lack of association in the second are compatible with the hypothesis that NPIs, per se, do not lead to a decline in case growth.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not align with any specific sub-category related to climate or ecological sustainable development but rather with infectious disease containment strategies.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this study, we explore the relationship between the growth of SARS-CoV-2 cases and an NPI stringency index.

new_primary_category.value: Public Health and Infectious Disease Control
new_primary_category.justification: The paper is fundamentally focused on public health interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic, which doesn't fit into existing climate or ecological sustainable development categories.
new_primary_category.quote: The study examines the stringency of non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on SARS-CoV-2 transmission.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: This new sub-category would specifically address studies that investigate strategies to control disease spread without pharmaceutical interventions.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The study examines the relationship between case growth and an NPI stringency index across different provinces.
